Went there 6 times in a week!
Dec 2017 • Family
The greeting might be surprising however it is a customary thing for a Japanese restaurant of this kind, the food was top quality at very decent price and we usually ate there for between 5 to 10 euros per person including drinks depending if you are starving or not. The fish is super fresh and every single dish we tried was amazing. Ask to be seated upstairs as it is super beautiful and you can even sit in one of the traditional Japanese Horigotatsu which are like a private dining room. The staff is super helpful and the draft beer if reasonably cheap for Sapporo a 3l tower will set you back 170 000 ( around 6 euros)

We would gladly come back if we ever go to HCM again well deserved 5 stars
